Compare actual named controlled destination matrices, frame origins, each source box vertex and named sites against independent interval enclosures. Dense checks supplement the complete interval certificate, never replace it.
cases.expected_physics_binding: Use the immutable physics and exact state values of p29-canonical-clock-addition; replace only complete interval/program/source identities by source_records here. Canonical numbers/anchors/counts/times remain equal.
cases.required_future_outcome: Complete accepted .22 artifact and independent supplied-byte/native/controlled-destination evidence. This is a future gate, not an observed success. Any cap/refusal remains a failure under this frozen allocation.

certificate_minimum_rules: Alpha=max exact absolute reference angular acceleration on each complete phase, including inherited transfer uncertainty; two independent Alpha fields cannot silently default to0.
Omega=max endpoint magnitude of the exact affine reference speed, including inherited angular uncertainty; never abs(net displacement)/duration.
Origin speed<=V_COM+rho*Omega and acceleration<=A_COM+rho*(Alpha+Omega^2), including full nested offset. Mesh/site local radius separately multiplies total angular error.
At p14 width1, Alpha=1/512,Omega=1/1024,rho100: phase chord1/4096 and origin chord51225/2097152; equal orientation endpoints alone cannot certify the moving100m marker.
Source quaternion chord Alpha*h^2/16+Omega^2*h^2/32; rotation plan(Alpha+Omega^2)*h^2/4; position plan A*h^2/8; all complete source,endpoint,clock,quaternion,destination terms remain required.
forbidden_normalization: Dropping unknown metadata fields or unordered arrays
Comparing geometry only by visual screenshots
Treating new-source GLB bytes as identical to old source-bound bytes

geometry_and_landmarks.matter: Every visual marker has own mass0/inertia null. Source sphere mass/inertia remain the independently frozen own quantities; marker geometry adds no mass.

metadata_difference_whitelist: Source-bound entry revision/provenance leaves on otherwise identical occurrences, only where independently recomputed from frozen new source.
Animation input/output accessor byte ranges, counts, extrema, offsets and buffer length caused solely by justified new exact key clocks and poses; re-decode every value and compare source.
Source-authorized execution request identity in new delivery/workflow variants.

small_source_pose_comparison.quaternion_sign: Minimum Euclidean difference against q and -q, using full saved-rotation left product intervals. Stored adjacent endpoint sign coherence remains a separate exact reader requirement.
small_source_pose_comparison.scope: Only31 small physics cases and their unchanged numeric delivery variants. Long-prefix domains and cap-boundary domain are excluded. The delivered .001 bounds are independently recomputed, not inferred from this sampled agreement.
